'''Robert Hallaman''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 53 FL from St Louis, Mo. At DecipherCon 1999 he finished 3rd in the [[Young Jedi]] Opposites Sealed Deck event and 18th in the YJ Qualifier.<ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj20_4">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_4.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Opposites Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001217013800/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_4.html Internet Archive]</ref>
